whatItIs: NaturesMud Banana Powder is milled from 100% whole Nepali bananas harvested in the fertile alluvial plains of Chitwan and Nawalpur. Each batch is peeled by hand, thinly sliced, gently dehydrated in closed sanitary chambers below 45°C, and cold-milled into a fine, creamy flour. It contains zero maltodextrin, zero added white sugar, zero milk solids, and zero chemical preservatives.
nepaliKitchenUses: Infant Weaning Porridge (Lito / Jaulo): Whisk 1 to 1.5 teaspoons (5g–8g) into warm cooked rice jaulo, suji kheer, or ragi porridge after turning off the stove (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician).
Morning Milk & Smoothie Thickener: Blend 1 tablespoon (10g) into warm milk, curd (dahi), or peanut-butter shakes for natural banana sweetness and potassium.
Soft Roti & Pancake Batter: Mix 2 tablespoons into whole-wheat atta or oat batter to make naturally soft, lightly sweet banana pancakes for school tiffin.
Post-Workout Shake Base: Combine 1 tablespoon with Roasted Almond paste and Dates Powder in milk or water for clean carbohydrate replenishment.
whoItSuits: Suits infants starting solid foods (from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician), toddlers needing calorie-dense tiffin meals, gym-goers seeking clean carbohydrates, and busy families wanting instant banana nutrition without fruit spoilage.
monsoonStorage: Dehydrated banana powder is naturally hygroscopic (absorbs moisture from humid air). During Nepal’s monsoon months (Ashadh–Bhadra), keep the inner seal closed, tighten the glass jar lid immediately after scooping, always use a bone-dry steel spoon, and store away from stove steam.

faqs.a: Yes, it is 100% single-ingredient dehydrated banana with 0 added sugar and 0 preservatives, making it suitable for baby weaning porridges (lito/jaulo) from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician.

faqs.q: Kasari prayog garne? Does Banana Powder need to be cooked?
faqs.a: You can stir 1 teaspoon directly into warm milk, yogurt, or freshly cooked jaulo, or cook it gently for 2–3 minutes in water/milk to make a smooth porridge.

faqs.q: Why does pure Banana Powder sometimes clump in humid weather?
faqs.a: Because we use 0% chemical anti-caking agents (no silicon dioxide or starch fillers), natural fruit sugars can clump if exposed to humid monsoon air. Simply break any soft clump with a dry spoon.

faqs.q: How many servings are in one 100 GM jar of Banana Powder?
